A Few Days With Darlene

About the Game

Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Darlene, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Darlene's enticing layers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971152/aaef2ac506fb49792495f92980a4f39140b2bba8.gif

Key Features
🗺️ Embark on a sensual heart-hunting adventure with the captivating Darlene.
🎮 Explore five beautiful-looking levels.
💖 Look for hidden hearts in each scene to further reveal Darlene's seductive charm.
🔞 Enjoy an erotic gaming experience suitable for adult audiences.

A Sexy Tour With Tanvi

About the Game

Embark on a titillating journey through India with Tanvi, your alluring tour guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with seductive reveals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971152/d06348cc16878ad24ab2acdbbd9a024d25539203.gif

Key Features   
🗺️ 5 breathtaking Indian locations to explore.    
👁️ 10 cleverly hidden differences in each scene.  
👗 Progressive undressing mechanic: The more differences you find, the more Tanvi reveals.    
🔞 Enjoy an erotic gaming experience suitable for adult audiences.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the Zoom In / Zoom Out feature could stop working when using the mouse wheel. This should never happen again. It's now possible to Zoom In / Out using CTRL and SHIFT on your Keyboard so you can play without using the mouse wheel. #LaptopFriendly 😉  Fixed an issue where a Raycast going through the Play button could cause a progression blocker.
